11.name: Break Dancin' 2: Electric Rugaloo
11.overview: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off as six queens from Bracket 1 break it down in an electrifying ‘80s-inspired performance. Guest judge La Toya Jackson is back – and the queens pay tribute in a dazzling “La Toyas R Us” runway.

11.name: Bar Queen Couture
11.overview: Tensions rise following the first MVQ Ceremony - and the queens are challenged to turn queer nightlife into couture using materials inspired by iconic gay bars. Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson joins the judges for this high-stakes runway showdown.

11.name: Shop Til U Drop
11.overview: With the scoreboard scrambled, the Bracket 1 queens transform into creatures of the night to pitch products on the Home Spooky Network. It’s their last chance to advance to the Semi-Finals - and their final MVQ ceremony - under the gaze of guest judge Christina Ricci.

11.name: Duets: It Takes Two
11.overview: Six new queens enter for Bracket 2 — and pair up to perform duets at the Sha-Blammy Awards. But will these musical matches make harmony or total chaos? Broadway star and pop icon Reneé Rapp joins the judges for this vocal showdown.

11.name: How-To Videos
11.overview: It’s DIY drag as the queens direct their own over-the-top How-To videos. But with tensions simmering and alliances in flux, this challenge could get messy. Gina Gershon brings her signature smolder to the judges panel.

11.name: Too Many Daddies
11.overview: For the final Bracket 2 challenge, the queens make over real-life gay dads. But family ties get tested and shocking twists await in the MVQ Ceremony. Abbott Elementary’s Janelle James lends her wit to the panel.

11.name: Athletic Supporter Design Challenge
11.overview: Bracket 3 begins as six new queens turn jockwear into glamazonian eleganza in a sporty design challenge. Who’ll score on the runway? Guest judge Juno Temple brings her British charm - and sharp critiques - to the judges panel.

11.name: Rappin' Roast Redux
11.overview: Feelings get fried as the Bracket 3 queens spit spicy verses in a raucous Rappin’ Roast. With shade flying and reps on the line, actor Brian Tyree Henry joins the judges panel to help decide who flowed and who flopped.

11.name: That's What She Said
11.overview: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the queens lip sync to classic ‘90s interviews from The RuPaul Show. With the semifinals in sight, the MVQ ceremony serves up drama as The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star Bronwyn Newport joins the judges panel.

11.name: Tell Me Something Good
11.overview: The Semifinalists return to face off – and the wildcard winner gags the Werkroom. Their first challenge: slay the “Tell Me Something Good” Story Hour, coached by guest judge, comedian Evan Mulrooney. But, a surprising twist leads to a startling elimination.

11.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble
11.overview: The top 7 queens put it all on the line in a no-holds-barred Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble. With spots in the finale at stake, expect showstoppers, stunts, and surprises. Guest judge Cooper Koch helps decide whose star power reigns supreme.

11.name: Disco Smackdown for the Crown
11.overview: It all comes down to this! The final 6 All Stars go head-to-head and toe-to-toe in a Disco Smackdown! But only one queen will claim victory, a $200,000 cash prize, and the coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

overview: The most celebrated competitors from RuPaul's Drag Race vie for a second chance to enter Drag Race herstory. This drag queen showdown is filled with plenty of heated competition, lip-syncing for the legacy, and, of course, the All-Stars Snatch Game.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: They come armed with stilettos, feathers, and sequins, prepared for a battle where one false move-or eyelash-could spell doom. They are the best of the best, the top queens from Drag Race seasons 1-4, and they're ready to lip-synch for their lives to determine which of these all-stars will claim the ultimate title and be declared Queen amongst queens.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A twist on the mega-hit RuPaul's Drag Race as queens from previous seasons are pitted against each other in a wig-to-wig drag battle royale.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: All Stars compete for $100,000 and a chance to be inducted into RuPaul's Drag Race Hall of Fame.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Unforgettable queens and Drag Race royalty take another shot at capturing the crown on RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars. The competitions will be as fierce as the runways, but only one queen can cement her legacy in The Drag Race Hall of Fame.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Drag Race royalty Alexis Mateo, Blair St. Clair, Derrick Barry, India Ferrah, Jujubee, Mariah Paris Balenciaga, Mayhem Miller, Miz Cracker, Ongina and Shea Coulee sashay back onto the runway for a chance at snatching the All Stars crown and nabbing a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Thirteen legendary queens return to RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars to claim a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! With more gag-worthy talents, jaw-dropping looks and epic performances, this is the biggest season of All Stars ever!

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: For the first time ever in the herstory of RuPaul's Drag Race, the series will feature a cast of all former winners returning to compete for the title "Queen of All Queens" and a cash prize of $200,000.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars brings back 12 of your favorite queens from across the Ru-niverse to compete for a coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! Plus, a new "Fame Games" twist means there's more than one way to win!

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Who will save the world? Drag Queens! RuPaul brings together eight of her most powerful All Stars to slay it forward in the name of charity. All season long, the queens will battle as they raise thousands of dollars for their favorite causes. But in the end, only one will win a coveted spot in the prestigious Drag Race Hall of Fame.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Let the games begin! 18 returning queens compete in the first-ever Tournament of All Stars, battling through brackets to test their charisma, uniqueness, nerve & talent! But only one queen will claim $200,000 and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: The Tournament of All Stars returns with 18 iconic queens battling it out in 3 fiercely competitive brackets. With points on the line and $200,000 at stake, who will make it to the finish line to claim a coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame?
